data.name: The Pool Lady
data.address: 5755 Carlisle Ct Suite 700, Fort Worth, TX 76180

reviews.text: We were having trouble getting our pool cleared up. After calling several people we found Laura. She has been AMAZING!! She was able to guide us through what we needed to do and now our pool is clear!! I cannot say enough about how wonderful she was. If I ever need pool help she is definitely who I will call first.
reviews.author: Misty Fleming

reviews.text: I requested the Pool Lady come out last Summer she came was here five minutes and told me I need a re plaster before she would clean my pool. I used her guys she recommended to plaster called her out this summer and now my pool filter is to small for my pool according to her. I have been living here for 18 years and my pool is crystal clear in then summer just got busy with work and can’t find the time to do it but before I use a dishonest person I will either do it myself or hire A quality pool to come do it oh and it took her three weeks to come out. Very unprofessional and only wants you to do upgrades that are not needed. Her vehicle should say “con artist” on the side of it.
reviews.author: Sandra Walter

reviews.text:
We have been using Laura and her crew for years.  Over the last 30 years we have had several pool service companies and non hold a candle to Laura.  They take care of our pool totally and do an excellent job.
You will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Cindy Boykin

reviews.text: I have used the Pool Lady Pool Service for about two years and my pool is in very good condition.   They do a good job and I have found them to be trustworthy.    The last pool company I used was very dishonest and honestly is important in business.   Thank you Laura and Allen.
reviews.author: Teresa Heckert

reviews.text: My backwash valve housing broke on Saturday morning.  Laura came out on Saturday afternoon.  They installed a new valve and fixed my plumbing at a very reasonable price.  Laura is very knowledgeable and courteous.  I would recommend her to anyone.  Thanks pool lady!
reviews.author: Bill Matheu

reviews.text: I found Rob on Google and he happened to be in the area and came within 10 minutes. Got us up and running for our new pool that had just been filled with water and no chemicals. He was kind, very well versed in everything related to our pool and funny as all get out. I would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Erica Davis

reviews.text:
They’re simply the best. We have had problems with our pool guy, that’s when we tried Laura and her Team. They solved everything at reasonable cost.
As a business owner I love their professionalism and integrity. Very rare in today’s world. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Rai Capel

reviews.text:
I wouldn’t use this company as they’re dishonest and take advantage of new pool owners. We didn’t know much about pools so the first time they came out to teach me about the equipment and pool they charged an $85 service fee without telling me upfront. For $85 dollar visit he went over the equipment and said an actuator was broke, which will be $350 and the heater was broke that we need a new circuit board and keypad which will cost from anywhere from $300 to $500 just for the circuit board and a couple hundred for the keypad. Then he started taking about the wireless controller and that it doesn’t control the heater and if I wanted it to work I would need an relay and wire, which would be another couple hundred dollars.  So I remembered we have a pool warranty so we decided to file a claim. I removed the new actuator they installed and put the old one back on.
So when the warranty guy came out, a few days later he looked at the system and in 5 seconds he saw a wire that wasn’t connected, which was a temp sensor into the heater. After he fixed that, everything worked, the heater, the old actuator and to top it off he said the controller does control the heater (which I tested and it worked).
So I went back and talked to the owner of the pool lady and she still said I owed for a service call.  So STAY AWAY, Dishonest company!
reviews.author: Jon Holzapfel

data.summary: The reviews appear largely authentic, reflecting a long-established business with a generally positive reputation. The low review count for a 21-year-old company is notable but not a definitive fake signal. Complaints center on communication and pricing transparency, not on catastrophic failures like taking deposits and ghosting. The specific details in both positive and negative reviews lend credibility.
fake_signals: Low total review volume (36) for a 21-year-old business
Some reviews are very old (5-7 years)
No recent reviews in the sample

negative_evidence: Complaint suggests recommended re-plaster and then later claimed filter was too small, implying shifting diagnosis

authentic_signals: Specific project details (backwash valve, actuator, circuit board)
Mentions of specific employees (Laura, Allen, Rob, Cole)
Mix of strong praise and specific complaints
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google and BBB provide ratings. BBB rating is high (A+), but this reflects complaint handling, not service quality. Google rating of 4.1 is solid. No contradictory low ratings from other major platforms.
